issues.legal_issue: Heirs who were unaware of a pending appeal and acted promptly after learning of it should be permitted to come on record despite technical defects in their applications concerning abatement and delay.
material_facts: The deceased had filed an appeal that remained pending when he died.
His heirs were unaware of the pending appeal until the advocate engaged by him contacted them.
After learning of the appeal, the heirs promptly contacted the advocate and applied to be brought on record.
The first application did not expressly seek to set aside abatement or condone delay, and the heirs later filed separate applications for those matters.
The lower courts rejected the applications on these technical grounds.
issues.conclusion: The rejections were set aside, the heirs were ordered to be brought on record, and the appellate court was directed to hear and decide the appeal on its merits after giving both sides an opportunity to be heard.
issues.legal_principle: Under Order 22, Rule 3 read with Section 151 of the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908, a hyper-technical approach should not prevent heirs from being substituted where they were unaware of the pending appeal and acted promptly after learning of it; omission of express prayers in the initial application does not justify rejection when separate applications are subsequently made. The Court relied on Ganeshprasad Badrinarayan Lahoti (D) by Lrs. v. Sanjeevprasad Jamnaprasad Chaurasiya & Anr., which it held directly covered the case.

rule.if: pending_appeal_and_appellant_died and heirs_unaware_of_appeal and heirs_acted_promptly_after_learning and substitution_application_made and separate_relief_applications_made

predicates.pending_appeal_and_appellant_died: An appellant died while an appeal filed by that appellant was pending.
predicates.heirs_unaware_of_appeal: The appellant's heirs did not know that the appeal was pending.
predicates.heirs_acted_promptly_after_learning: The heirs acted promptly after learning from the deceased appellant's advocate that the appeal was pending.
predicates.substitution_application_made: The heirs applied to be brought on record in place of the deceased appellant.
predicates.separate_relief_applications_made: The heirs made separate applications seeking the procedural reliefs omitted from their initial substitution application.

issues.definition: When an appellant dies during a pending appeal, heirs who were unaware of the appeal, act promptly on learning of it, and make substitution and separate relief applications are to be brought on record so the appeal can be decided on its merits.
